item: Tier-2 #19 computational cost benchmark (measured wall times)

hardware.note: single small shared box; no GPU; times are CPU wall seconds

stages.stage: Phase-2 ridge probe, 250 genes + 50 pathways, per LOPO fold (10 folds)
stages.basis: per-fold times printed by scripts/p2_model.py; total = sum of folds

stages.stage: Scanner logistic fit, per LOPO fold
stages.basis: per-fold times in scanner stability run (same recipe as committed scanner)

stages.stage: Pathway permutation test, 10,000 reps, per patient (BIMODAL: 5 patients 261-276s via Gram-invariant shared fits; 5 patients 7,196-13,703s full refits before the invariant path; total is sum of both)
G2-X external evaluation v2 (4,325 spots: CTransPath embed + frozen head + gates)
stages.basis: wall time printed by scripts/g2x_external_eval_v2.py; embed alone 2171s (0.50 s/spot)

stages.stage: CTransPath extraction, all 68 sections (batch run incl. interrupted reruns)
stages.basis: first-to-last mtime of embeddings_cache/*.npz; upper bound incl. idle gaps; steady-state rate 0.50 s/spot from G2-X line

stages.stage: Multitask PLS + reduced-rank ridge, per patient (both fits)

fresh_rerun_checks.basis: wall time of scripts/p2_scanner_calibration.py run 2026-09-29 (10 LOPO folds, 12,897 held-out spots, replay-exact)
